Dialogs.Dialog: By the way, the tests are coming up. Have you been studying？ Hey, how about a review session at my house？
You already know what will be covered in the tests, right？ Um, how about we review the lessons together in my room？
Have you studied for the tests？ If you have anything you don't understand, Takane-sensei can teach you.
Then once you're ready, come over to my house, okay？
Hehe. That's good. I'll be waiting then.
Hehe, very good. Come over after school, okay？
I see. Too bad... Then maybe next time.
I see... Sorry, I didn't even ask if you were free. I hope we can study together next time...
Hmm, such a confident answer. Then let's study on our own this time？
▲主人公＊▲. Perfect timing. Hey, want to study together after this？ I can't focus on my own...
Right. The tests are coming up...
▲主人公＊▲. What a coincidence！ Hey, if you have time... want to study for the tests together after this？
▲主人公＊▲. I was just about to message you. Hey, want to study together？
Ah, the tests are coming up. Let me see...
Really？ Hehe, I'm glad. Then I'll wait at home. Get ready and come see me, okay？
Hehe, I'm so happy. Then I'll get things ready at home？ See you later.
Yeah, let's do this！ ...Just kidding. So, will you come to my house later？
I see... Then I'll ask you another day？ Bye.
Ah... I see. Then I'll ask some other time？ Bye.
Aww... Hehe, just kidding. Too bad, though... Make sure you're free next time, okay？
There's something I don't get. Want to study together？
Really？ Then let's do it in my room.
There's something I don't get. Want to study together？
There's something I don't get. Want to study together？
Then I'll teach you in my room... Hehe.
(Ugh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s nerves are rubbing off on me too...)
This is the first time a boy's been in my room... I'm nervous.
(If you say that, I'll get nervous too...)
Let's focus and study hard today too, okay？
I hope we get a lot done？
I hope we can study efficiently today.
Um, I feel embarrassed so please don't look around too much.
Don't look there. Hehe, you're hopeless.
Ah, you're looking again. Are you that curious about a girl's room？ Geez.
Coffee, black tea, green tea, water... What'll it be today？ Hehe！
Have a seat？ Let's get started？
Here you go. Make yourself comfortable？
Okay, I'll quiz you. Get them all right and you'll get a reward, so do your best.
Hmm... Think a little more and I'm sure you'll get it？
See, that's what you get for not reviewing.
Can we go to the next question？
Yes, very well done. I'll give you your reward？
Hehe, impressive. Now, your reward... okay？
Hehe, well done▼ As promised, maybe I'll give you a reward.
So close！ Just a little more and you'd get the reward.
So close, but... Sorry, I don't think I can give you the reward for this.
Too bad！ You're one step away from the reward？
...Really？ If that's what you want, that's fine.
Geez... At this rate, there's no talk of any reward？
Are you maybe not feeling well？ Are you okay？
I want to give you a reward... Think you can get motivated？
That's the spirit！ Hehe, let's do our best？
...I see. This isn't much of a study session, then.
...Geez. Fine, I'll throw in a bonus. ...Just this once, okay？
Can I come... a little closer？
...I'd only do this in front of you, okay？
Hey, how is it？ I'd be happy if it's what you were hoping for...
The clothes you gave me as a present... Hey, keep it a secret from everyone, okay？
I thought I'd like you to see... Does it suit me？
...Do you like this kind of thing？ What do you think？
I wanted you to be happy... Do you not like me like this？
Time's up, I guess？ ...Phew, my heart's still pounding...
That's as far as it goes, okay？ ...I did something pretty bold, didn't I？ So embarrassing...
Hehe, that's it. My heart was really pounding...
...Hey, want to take another quiz？ Then I'll show you a different outfit...
...Okay. We'll save the fun for next time, then？
You worked hard, didn't you？ So... this is special.
You worked so hard, so I thought I'd do my part too... How is it？
If this doesn't get you motivated... I'll be mad.
Will this get you motivated...？ It's embarrassing, but for you...
It's really embarrassing, you know？ But... if it gets you motivated, I guess that's fine.
It's kind of embarrassing after all...
Come on... Don't you have anything to say？
What do I do, I can't calm down...
Are you just going to keep quiet？
...Hey, could you look away, just for a bit？ Because...
When you look at me like that, I...
Don't look so much？ It's embarrassing...
Is there some part that catches your eye？
Don't look at me with that face. Geez... Dummy.
I don't like being stared at...
Maybe because I'm dressed differently than usual？ My heart's pounding right now...
...Even if I stay dressed like this... you won't stop liking me？
Okay, that's it for today, I think？
With this, you should do well on the tests, right？
Now I can relax. I guess being your teacher paid off？ Hehe.
It wasn't bad, but... a little more, maybe？
I think you can do a little better. Let's work hard？
Hmm. "Needs a little more effort," I'd say？ Hehe.
I'm a little... No, pretty worried, actually.
Um... Maybe you should study a bit more seriously？
It's already this late... Time to call it a day, I guess...
Hey, what do you want to do？ ...Are you going home？
Really？ Then, can you wait for me just a bit？
Thanks for today. I'm glad I was able to study with you.
I'm sorry, I wasn't able to concentrate much...
It turned into a bit of a strange study session, huh？
Isn't something like this nice once in a while？
